Lacrimal Sac Abscess: Imaging: unremarkable optic nerve appearance on follow-up CT
Medical history: several months of epiphora without prior dacryocystitis
Diffuse limitation in extraocular movements in the left eye
Imaging: Coronal Computed Tomography Scan showed left-sided lacrimal sac abscess
Imaging: postseptal fat stranding largely limited to the extraconal space
Imaging: opacification of both nasolacrimal ducts
Imaging: Repeat Contrast-Enhanced Computed Tomography showed increased abscess size with globe compression
Laboratory: Initial cultures isolated gram-positive cocci in chains
Laboratory: later identified as pan-susceptible Streptococcus pyogenes
